extracted.name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Ham
extracted.description: Cream and ham with Parmesan and a touch of butter.
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.
In a medium sauce pan over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in ham and cook 1 minute. Stir in cream and heat through. Stir in Parmesan and cook until thick and smooth. Toss with cooked pasta.
